meta.name: Who Is Erin Carter
meta.description: A British woman's tranquil life in Barcelona spirals out of control when an armed robbery at a supermarket exposes her secret... and violent past.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Erin's picturesque life takes a turn for the unexpected when she single-handedly subdues armed robbers in a supermarket stickup, stunning her daughter.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Erin's nosy neighbor on the police force comes asking for assistance even as she tries to put on a happy face for her daughter.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Erin scrambles to erase evidence of her actions, pulling her deeper into danger. Harper grows increasingly suspicious of her.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A glimpse into Erin's past reveals how she arrived at motherhood and unveils the shocking secrets that she has been rushing to conceal.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As Emilio closes in on crucial evidence, his investigation is averted. Erin is forced to fess up to her husband and daughter.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A ghost from Erin's past comes searching for her with a vengeance, putting her and her loved ones at risk.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Erin must team up with an unlikely partner to save what is most dear to her. A daring break in results in the ultimate sacrifice.
